messages:
maria: Heads up — after the region-weighted routing rollout, our sampled telemetry for /v1/chat looks biased. Only eu-west is contributing most of the sampled payloads. Anyone else seeing per-route PII sampling drift?

alex: yep, I noticed console showed sampled_count down in us-east. My hunch: sampler salt is tied to instance/cluster id so the same tenant hashes differently across regions.

ben: that matches what I saw. Did we switch from tenant-stable-id -> instance_id anywhere in the deploy?

irene: @alex @ben we did, for a short-lived migration to debug affinity. Bad idea — that makes sampling non-deterministic across routing.

maria: can we migrate back without losing auditability? I'm worried we might miss PII coverage during the flip.

alex: propose a migration plan: 1) enable dual-hash acceptance (legacy OR new) for 48h, 2) emit per-request flags for legacy_vs_new, 3) canary on 1% traffic then ramp.

ben: dual-hash is safe. Also request console changes: show 'sampled volume by region' and a masked preview toggle so SREs can sanity-check sampling without exposing raw text.

maria: agreed — preview must mask tokens and show sampling rule id + reason. No raw user text.

telemetry-bot: Alert — sample-rate-drift detected: /v1/chat >30% difference (eu-west vs us-east).

irene: ingestion changes: tag sampled records with metadata {legacy_sampling: true|false, sampling_rule: "hash_v2"} so backfills can reconcile.

alex: config snippet I'll PR:
```json
{"sampling": {"strategy": "hash", "salts": ["instance_id", "tenant_stable_id"], "accept_either": true, "migration_ttl_secs": 172800}}
```

ben: :thumbsup: add an operator knob in the console to flip accept_either->false after we confirm overlap. Also expose legacy_vs_new_ratio meter.

maria: QA checklist: nightly comparator job to compute sampled_set_overlap_pct by tenant; require >80% overlap after 24h before full flip. If <80%, auto-rollback.

irene: I'll add dashboards: per-route sampled_count, sampled_unique_tenants, legacy_vs_new_ratio, sample_overlap_pct, and an annotation stream for the rollout.

alex: I'll own the PR and the rollout tomorrow morning. Can someone draft the runbook for breakglass (how to revert salt, how to disable sampling at edge)?

maria: adding a short runbook item and we should push an alert to #eng-oncall when legacy_vs_new_ratio crosses 10% drift with a link to the runbook.

ben: minor note — make sure KV cache and batching layers don't alter sample tagging order. We should tag before any batching/coalescing.

irene: good call. We'll tag at the ingress boundary and carry the flag through the pipeline.

maria: thanks all — let's try to keep the console preview conservative and the migration visible. Update thread with PR link when ready.
